battle.name: 克羅地亞戰爭
battle.brief: 克羅地亞戰爭始於1991年6月克羅地亞宣布獨立後，初期交戰涉及正規軍隊、準軍事組織與地方武裝之間的對抗，戰線遍及境內多個區域，並逐步擴展為長期戰爭。此處所列英國正式裝備型號Enfield rifle於1858年列裝，屬於更早的英國陸軍步兵武器序列。

kit.name: 恩菲爾德步槍
kit.history: Enfield rifle位於英國陸軍的步兵武器序列，屬地面兵種裝備，主要配置予步兵及遠征部隊，承擔制式步槍在殖民地防衛與軍事行動中的角色。

countries: 一九九一年的克羅地亞戰爭，是南斯拉夫解體過程中爆發的內戰階段，交戰主體是南斯拉夫人民軍與克羅地亞國防力量。塞軍以駐斯普利特的第九軍團負責達爾馬提亞戰區，以駐波斯尼亞的第三軍團支援西部戰線，另有自維沃丁那與塞爾維亞本土調來的部隊；克方則以一九九〇年成立的國民警衛隊、一九九一年五月整編而成的克羅地亞國民衛隊，以及同年六月依法恢復的克羅地亞空軍與海軍為主幹，輔以各州警察與地方民兵。北線由斯拉沃尼亞大橋與奧西耶克構成，東線在奧西耶克與武科瓦爾之間拉開，西線則以利諾、庫普雷斯與利卡山區為爭奪焦點。塞軍背後是塞爾維亞共和國的軍政結構與克拉伊納地方武裝，克軍背後是薩格勒布的總參謀部與波黑克羅地亞人的武裝。戰場橫跨今日的克羅地亞、波黑與塞爾維亞邊界，因此任何一份作戰序列都必須把三方的部隊編號一併記錄，否則無法說明同一天在不同戰線上發生的交鋒。
countriesEn: The 1991 phase of the Croatian war was an internal war born of the dissolution of Yugoslavia, fought between the Yugoslav People's Army on one side and the Croatian defence forces on the other. The JNA used its 9th Corps at Split for the Dalmatian theatre, its 3rd Corps in Bosnia to support the western front, and formations transferred from Vojvodina and metropolitan Serbia. On the Croatian side the backbone was the National Guard created in 1990, the Croatian National Guard reorganised in May 1991, and the Croatian Air Force and Navy restored by statute in June 1991, backed by regional police and local militia. The northern front was anchored by the Slavonia bridge and Osijek, the eastern front ran through the Osijek and Vukovar sector, and the western front centred on Livno, Kupres and the Lika highlands. Behind the JNA stood the military-political machinery of the Republic of Serbia and the Krajina forces; behind the Croatian army stood the General Staff in Zagreb and the Croat forces of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Because the battlefield crossed what are now Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Serbia, any order of battle has to record designations from all three sides, otherwise the clashes fought on the same day on different axes cannot be explained.
people: 克方最高層的政治與軍事決策由總統弗朗約・圖季曼作出，他主張以軍事手段解決塞爾維亞控制區問題，並在一九九一年八月初拍板發動大規模反攻；克羅地亞總參謀長茲沃尼米爾・切爾文科負責擬定計畫，前線則由安特・戈托維納將軍率領克軍主力，戈托維納此後成為塞爾維亞方面指控與追訴的重點人物。塞軍一端由武裝部隊總司令瓦西里耶・韋利奇科維奇上將與總參謀長茲維塔・帕尼奇主持作戰，前總參謀長揚科・博貝特科亦在其中。塞爾維亞共和國總統斯洛博丹・米洛舍維奇透過塞軍與克拉伊納的聯合指揮機制施加影響；「塞爾維亞自治區克拉伊納」由米蘭・巴比奇掌政，國防與武裝一線則有塞爾維亞內政部特種部隊指揮官米蘭・格韋羅。波黑方面由總統阿利雅・伊澤特貝戈維奇主持國防會議，波黑克羅地亞人的武裝由赫爾瓦特科・武科維奇率領。作戰層面上，內政部特種警察與國民衛隊各旅的指揮官直接帶隊，其臨場判斷往往比後方機關的正式命令更能左右局部戰果。
peopleEn: Political and military decisions on the Croatian side were taken at the top by President Franjo Tudjman, who favoured settling the Serb-held areas by military means and personally approved the major counter-offensive in early August 1991. The Croatian Chief of General Staff Zvonimir Cervenko drew up the plan, and General Ante Gotovina led the main Croatian forces in the field, which later made him the focus of Serbian indictment. On the JNA side operations were run from the army command under Admiral Vasilije Velickovic and Chief of General Staff Zivota Panic, with the former chief Janko Bobetko also involved. Serbia's President Slobodan Milosevic influenced events through the joint command arrangements linking the JNA and Krajina. Milan Babic governed the Serb Autonomous Region of Krajina, while Milan Gvero, commander of the Serbian Interior Ministry special units, ran the hard line on the security side. In Bosnia and Herzegovina President Alija Izetbegovic chaired the defence councils, and the Croat forces were led by Hrvatko Vukovic. At the tactical level commanders of the Interior Ministry special police and of the National Guard brigades led their men directly, and their on-the-spot judgement often mattered more than formal orders from the rear.
kits: 雙方裝備基本上是同一套南斯拉夫軍火庫存，差別在數量、可用率與補充速度。塞軍主戰坦克為國產M-84與進口T-72、T-72M1，另有數量不多的T-80；裝甲車以BTR-80與M-80為主。砲兵骨幹是130公厘M-46M2榴彈砲、152公厘D-20與122公厘D-30，自走砲有2S1「古沃茲迪卡」與2S3「阿卡恰」，火箭砲使用BM-21「格拉德」。步兵武器是Zastava M70系列手槍與步槍、AKM、RPG-7發射器與AT-3「薩格」反裝甲筒，通用機槍為PKM及同級機槍；防空配備9K33「箭」、9K37「楊樹」與9K22「方塊」中程系統。克軍保留了J-21與J-21bis米格-21、米格-19及G-2「海鷗」教練與攻擊機，塞軍航空兵則有米格-21、米格-29與少數Su-22，並以米格-21與地面攻擊機配合游擊隊作戰。克方步兵精銳單位另獲M16A1、M60、FN MAG與AT-4反裝甲筒，後者是近衛旅在高速公路與山區反伏擊的主要兵器。雙方砲兵同樣受底火藥限制，130公厘砲標準射程約二十七至三十公里，152公厘D-20約十七至十八公里，因此砲戰多在射擊諸元受限的短程交火中進行。
kitsEn: The two sides drew on essentially the same Yugoslav ordnance stocks, and the real differences were numbers, readiness and the speed of resupply. The JNA's main battle tanks were the domestically built M-84 and imported T-72 and T-72M1, with a small number of T-80s; armoured vehicles were chiefly BTR-80 and M-80. The artillery backbone was the 130 mm M-46M2 howitzer, the 152 mm D-20 and the 122 mm D-30, with 2S1 Gvozdika and 2S3 Akatsia self-propelled guns and BM-21 Grad rocket launchers. Infantry weapons were the Zastava M-70 series of pistols and rifles, AKM rifles, RPG-7 launchers and AT-3 Sagger anti-tank tubes, with PKM and comparable machine guns; air defence included 9K33 Osa, 9K37 Strela and the 9K22 Kvadrat medium-range system. Croatia retained J-21 and J-21bis MiG-21s, MiG-19s and G-2 Galeb trainers and light attack aircraft, while the JNA air force flew MiG-21s, MiG-29s and a few Su-22s, using MiG-21 and ground attack aircraft in support of JNA guerrilla formations. Croatian infantry elite units also received M16A1 rifles, M60 and FN MAG machine guns and AT-4 anti-tank launchers, the last being the main weapon of counter-ambush kills along motorway and mountain axes. Both sides' artillery was constrained by propellant charges: the 130 mm gun had a standard range of roughly 27 to 30 kilometres and the 152 mm D-20 about 17 to 18 kilometres, so artillery duels settled mostly into short-range fire at reduced ranges.
tactics: 塞軍在九一年的戰法大致沿用傳統團級進攻：由數個營的直射砲兵先以三至五發急速射擊壓制目標，再由坦克營引導摩步旅前推；遇到城鎮與山脊要點則改為逐屋逐巷攻堅，配合迫擊砲與機槍封頂。砲兵普遍採取射擊即轉移，發射三至數發後立即換位，以躲避反砲兵雷達與精確校正火力。克軍在斯拉沃尼亞與克拉伊納初期以十至十五公里的縱深野戰防守陣地為主，工兵在道路與河谷要道埋設地雷，並以直射砲火在反斜面建立交錯火力網；地方警察與民兵則利用熟悉地形進行游擊與襲擊。進入一九九一年下半年，克軍戰術明顯轉向機動：部隊沿數條平行公路夜間行軍，嚴格控制無線電發報，靠摩托化步兵分隊與工兵開路小組繞過據點，坦克縱隊在鄉間道路上以縱隊形式快速推進，前沿不戀戰、不佔領非必要城鎮，後方由薩格勒布、卡爾洛瓦茨與西薩克構成的補給走廊及俘獲的塞軍火藥庫支撐。八月「暴風雨」行動即以此戰法摧毀西線，九月「烏納」行動則把同一套打法用於比哈奇盆地，並在聯合國觀察員見證下劃出停火線。
tacticsEn: The JNA offensive method in 1991 followed traditional regimental doctrine: several batteries of direct-fire guns first put three to five rounds in quick salvo onto a target, then tank-led motorised infantry pushed forward, and where towns and ridge lines were involved the advance turned into house-by-house assault supported by mortars and machine-gun fire from commanding heights. Artillery batteries almost universally used shoot-and-scoot, firing a few rounds and then displacing to escape counter-battery radar and precision correction fire. Croatia's initial posture in Slavonia and Krajina was a field defence some ten to fifteen kilometres deep, with engineers mining the key roads and river approaches and direct-fire guns interlocking fields of fire on reverse slopes; local police and militia relied on intimate knowledge of the ground for raids and ambushes. In the second half of 1991 the Croatian method clearly turned mobile: formations moved by night along parallel roads with strict radio silence, motorised infantry teams and engineer route-clearing groups bypassed strongpoints, tank columns advanced in column of route along country roads, the leading echelon neither fought pitched battles nor occupied towns it did not need, and the rear was supplied through the Zagreb, Karlovac and Sisak corridor and captured JNA ammunition dumps. Operation Storm in August destroyed the western front on that method, and Operation Una in September applied the same approach in the Bihac basin, with a ceasefire line drawn under UN observer supervision.
data: 可核對的節點如下：一九九一年六月二十五日克羅地亞舉行獨立公投並同日宣布獨立，塞軍自六月十九日起從科索沃向克羅地亞調動；七月七日布里奧尼協議要求塞軍撤出克羅地亞與斯洛維尼亞，撤出的部隊隨即沿克拉基耶維卡、貝爾格萊德、諾維比薩爾至斯普利特一線重新部署，戰線因此在克羅地亞境內拉長。冬季行動自一月八日至三月十八日，春季行動自三月二日至三月二十一日，「閃電」行動自三月二十九日至五月九日；九月下旬聯合國安理會通過第713號決議對南斯拉夫實施全面武器禁運，九月十六日塞方宣布成立「塞爾維亞自治區克拉伊納及西波斯尼亞」。八月三日克羅地亞方面決定反攻，四日拂曉發動炮火準備，五日克寧、德里尼斯、多尼亞拉帕克、科斯塔伊尼察與斯盧尼相繼易手，八日至九日希貝尼克、戈斯皮奇與諾維格拉德失守，十一日至十三日比哈奇、波斯尼亞諾維、波斯尼亞彼得羅瓦茨與桑斯基莫斯特被占領，十八日德沃爾落入克軍之手，九月二日至五日「烏納」行動重奪比哈奇方向。兵力方面，塞軍在衝突高峰動員以數十萬計，真正部署在克羅地亞前線的正規軍約數萬人，地方武裝另計；克方武裝力量在八月初達十萬人上下，波黑克軍與民兵再另加數萬。火砲以數千門計，雙方均因消耗與補給不足而在四至六週內需要後方重建。傷亡只能引用量級：九一年至九二年停火前，克方公布的陣亡與失蹤約一萬三千人、負傷約二萬五千人，塞方與外國研究者的對應估算常在一、二千至四、五千之間；「暴風雨」一役克方陣亡與失蹤多估為一千至一千五百人，塞方則從數千至近萬不等，且當時陣亡申報、戰俘移交與失蹤登記事務幾近失靈。
dataEn: The verifiable milestones run as follows. On 25 June 1991 Croatia held an independence referendum and declared independence the same day, and the JNA began moving troops from Kosovo into Croatia on 19 June. The Brioni Accord of 7 July required the JNA to withdraw from Croatia and Slovenia, and the withdrawing formations redeployed along the Krk, Belgrade, Novi Sad and Split axis, lengthening the front inside Croatian territory. Operation Winter ran from 8 January to 18 March, Operation Spring from 2 to 21 March, and Operation Flash from 29 March to 9 May. In late September the UN Security Council adopted Resolution 713 imposing a comprehensive arms embargo on Yugoslavia, and on 16 September the Serb side proclaimed the Serb Autonomous Region of Krajina and Western Bosnia. Croatia decided on the counter-offensive on 3 August, artillery preparation opened before dawn on the 4th, and Knin, Drnis, Donji Lapac, Kostajnica and Slunj changed hands on the 5th, followed by Sibenik, Gospic and Novigrad on the 8th and 9th, then Bihac, Bosanski Novi, Bosanski Petrovac and Sanski Most between the 11th and 13th, and Dvor on the 18th; Operation Una recovered the Bihac axis between 2 and 5 September. In manpower, the JNA mobilisation peaked in the hundreds of thousands while only tens of thousands of regular troops were actually deployed on the Croatian front, with local formations counted separately; the Croatian armed forces reached roughly one hundred thousand by early August, with tens of thousands more from the Bosnian Croat forces and militia. Artillery on both sides ran into thousands of tubes, and each army needed to rebuild its rear areas within four to six weeks because consumption outpaced resupply. Casualties can only be quoted as orders of magnitude: for the period up to the 1992 ceasefire Croatia published about 13,000 killed and missing and some 25,000 wounded, while Serbian and foreign studies commonly give one to two thousand up to four or five thousand for the other side. In Operation Storm alone Croatian killed and missing are usually estimated at one thousand to one thousand five hundred, against Serbian losses given anywhere from several thousand to close to ten thousand, and the wartime reporting, prisoner transfer and missing-person registration systems were close to collapse.
cause: 戰爭的成因有政治與軍事兩層。一九九〇年克羅地亞與塞爾維亞先後舉行選舉，圖季曼領導的克羅地亞民主聯盟取得執政，主張主權與獨立的同時改革經濟；塞爾維亞的民族主義政黨則主張塞爾維亞人組成的南斯拉夫保持統一，並掌握聯邦主席團多數席次，能對軍隊與預算施加影響。南斯拉夫人民軍在九〇年末至九一年初已停止對達爾馬提亞的常態供應，並把軍隊集中到塞爾維亞本土，使克羅地亞沿海與內陸的供應鏈迅速惡化，這是衝突的直接導火線之一。一九九一年六月聯邦主席團提出把各共和國武裝整合進聯邦聯盟體系的方案，企圖以軍事威懾維持南斯拉夫框架，圖季曼在二十五日拒絕，獨立公投與宣言同日完成，此後塞軍大舉進入克羅地亞與斯洛維尼亞，克軍與國民衛隊被推到應戰位置。塞爾維亞方面的另一條線是克羅地亞境內塞族聚居區的武裝化：地方武裝先後在克拉伊納、利卡與斯拉沃尼亞奪據點，聯邦軍以砲火與裝甲部隊支援，使雙方都失去退讓空間；一九九一年七月的布里奧尼協議只換來暫時停火，未解決武器、編制與版圖爭議，九月的武器禁運更切斷了正常補充，使作戰完全依賴既有庫存與繳獲物資。
causeEn: The causes of the war operated on both political and military levels. Croatia and Serbia held elections in 1990, and Tudjman's Croatian Democratic Union took power advocating sovereignty and independence alongside economic reform, while Serbia's nationalist parties argued for preserving a Yugoslavia composed of Serbs and gained enough seats on the federal presidency to influence the army and the budget. From late 1990 into early 1991 the Yugoslav People's Army had already stopped routine supply to Dalmatia and concentrated its troops in metropolitan Serbia, so the supply chain of the Croatian coast and hinterland deteriorated rapidly, and this was one of the immediate triggers. In June 1991 the federal presidency proposed integrating the republics' armed forces into a confederal structure, attempting to hold Yugoslavia together by military intimidation; Tudjman rejected it on the 25th, the referendum and the declaration of independence were completed the same day, and the JNA then entered Croatia and Slovenia in force, pushing the Croatian army and the National Guard into the responding position. The other Serbian line was the arming of Serb-populated areas inside Croatia: local forces seized ground first in Krajina, Lika and Slavonia, and federal artillery and armoured formations supported them, so neither side retained room to give ground. The Brioni Accord of July 1991 bought only a temporary pause and left weapons, force structures and territorial claims unresolved, and the September arms embargo closed off normal resupply, leaving combat entirely dependent on existing stocks and captured materiel.
impact: 一九九一年的戰局改變了戰爭的地理與政治結構。塞軍在西線與北線的陣地被整批切斷，克拉伊納守軍被擠往波斯尼亞西部，塞爾維亞南部與波斯尼亞塞軍的地盤首次連成一片，這條連接線在九二年之後成為波黑戰爭北翼的支撐。塞軍內部因連續失利與指揮權爭議而重組，一九九二年人民軍改組為南斯拉夫軍，聯邦編制解體；克軍則從民兵性質的國民衛隊轉為以旅、軍團為骨架的正規化部隊，第七與第十五近衛軍團正是在此過程中形成，一九九二年元月正式編為克羅地亞軍。戰爭同時把國際行為者拉入：歐洲共同體的監督團自一九九一年七月起在前線設立觀察點並於秋季擴大，聯合國九月下旬實施武器禁運，北約的觀察與空中監察小組則在一九九二年波黑戰爭爆發後才介入，使這場內戰自九二年起成為歐洲安全的核心議題。波黑克羅地亞人武裝在戰爭中坐大，組織與裝備更趨完整，之後在波黑戰役中成為決定性角色，也因此承受塞族方面的攻擊壓力。法制與外交層面的落後同樣留下後遺症：九一年的作戰命令與戰俘補充文件幾乎全部散失，傷兵安置、陣亡通知與失蹤調查缺乏統一體系，使各方日後進入歐洲安全機構時仍難以對同一套標準達成共識。
impactEn: The course of 1991 reshaped the geography and politics of the war. The JNA's positions on the western and northern fronts were cut in wholesale blocks, the Krajina army was squeezed back into western Bosnia, and for the first time the territory of southern Serbia was joined to that of the Bosnian Serbs, a linkage that later supported the northern flank of the Bosnian war. The JNA itself was reorganised after continuous failure and disputes over command, with the People's Army replaced in 1992 by the Army of Republika Srpska and the federal structure dissolved. The Croatian army moved from a militia-type National Guard to a regularised force built around brigades and corps, the 7th and 15th Guards Corps taking shape in that process and the Croatian Army being formally constituted in January 1992. At the same time the war pulled international actors in: the European Community monitoring mission established observation posts on the front from July 1991 and expanded in the autumn, the United Nations imposed an arms embargo in late September, and NATO observation and air monitoring units arrived only after the Bosnian war began in 1992, making this internal conflict a core European security issue from that year on. The Croat forces of Bosnia and Herzegovina grew stronger during the fighting, with more complete organisation and equipment, and became decisive players in the Bosnian war, which in turn exposed them to Serb attack pressure. Institutional weakness also left a legacy: operational orders and prisoner paperwork from 1991 were largely lost, and the care of the wounded, notification of the dead and missing-person investigation lacked any unified system, so it remained difficult for the parties to agree common standards when they later entered European security arrangements.
result: 以一九九一年為止的戰役算，勝負已定。八月四日至七日的「暴風雨」行動摧毀塞軍在克羅地亞境內的主要野戰體系，克拉伊納首府克寧與克軍所屬重鎮相繼失守，第九軍團的指揮中樞與前線補給體系一併崩解；九月「烏納」行動又把塞軍在波斯尼亞西北的反撲壓回去，比哈奇盆地重回克軍與波黑克軍控制，此後直到冬季，雙方在克羅地亞境內再未出現能改變版圖的大規模攻勢。戰局因此凍結成克羅地亞、塞爾維亞克拉伊納與波黑三方之間的漫長接觸線，這條線日後成為凡茨—歐文方案中聯合國特別保護區的基礎，也是一九九二年三月聯合國保護部隊進駐時的實際界線。一九九二年一月中旬停火協議達成，一月二十日凡茨—歐文方案提出，各共和國陸續獲國際承認，克羅地亞於五月二十二日加入聯合國。但一九九一年的結局並非整場戰爭的終點：主戰場在一九九二年四月轉入波黑與薩拉熱窩，克拉伊納問題直到一九九五年十一月代頓協議簽署才最終解決。因此準確的記法是：一九九一年階段以克羅地亞在克羅地亞境內的戰爭勝利與停火線成立告終，整場南斯拉夫解體戰爭則要到一九九五年才畫上句點。
resultEn: Judged as the war of 1991 alone, the outcome was settled. Operation Storm from 4 to 7 August destroyed the JNA's main field system inside Croatia, the Krajina capital Knin and the towns held by Croatian forces fell in turn, and the command centre and forward supply structure of the 9th Corps collapsed with them. Operation Una in September pushed back the Serb counter-offensive in north-western Bosnia and returned the Bihac basin to Croatian and Bosnian Croat control, and neither side mounted another major offensive capable of changing the map inside Croatia before the winter. The front froze into a long contact line between Croatia, the Serbian Krajina and Bosnia, a line that later became the basis of the United Nations Special Protected Areas in the Vance-Owen plan and the practical boundary when United Nations peacekeepers deployed in March 1992. A ceasefire agreement was reached in mid-January 1992, the Vance-Owen plan was submitted on 20 January, the republics were progressively recognised, and Croatia joined the United Nations on 22 May. Yet the end of 1991 was not the end of the war: the main theatre shifted to Bosnia and Sarajevo in April 1992, and the Krajina question was not finally settled until the Dayton agreements of November 1995. The accurate formulation is therefore that the 1991 phase ended in a Croatian victory inside Croatia and the establishment of a ceasefire line, while the entire war of Yugoslavia's dissolution was not closed until 1995.
